description: Dawit follows up his recent Future Times Dawit & Dolo single with a stunner of an EP on his own label. Stretched out soul, dizzy hand drums, and silky vocals abound on Corona. Gravity flexes, New Life bops, Sufferation Dub glides on a deep bassline, and Dawit shows off his voice in Luna's Medley.
credits:
Mixed by Dawit Eklund and Pete Markoski
Mastered by Dietrich Schoenemann
